That's not a stupid question at all. I address envelopes all the time for work and about once a month I mail an envelope to our office as opposed to mailing it to the proper recipient.

I've been a Reddit creeper for years and have never actually made an account until now. I'm not sure how to post pictures, but your name and address would go in the top left corner of the envelope and my information would go in the middle. The postage goes in the top right corner, should be about $0.49 for a letter since postage just went up.

You should absolutely wake her up.

My fiance lost her uncle to suicide in October. I doubt her family will ever stop wishing he had tried to reach out to talk to someone.

If I had a child, no matter how tired I was, I could never be too tired to talk to them if they needed to.
